title: Neighbours
subject: Should the bins rota go back to weekly?

comments.author: Ines
comments.text: We tried a shared rota at our building for two years. It only worked once we stopped assigning whole weeks and split it into small jobs anyone could pick up on the day, with a board by the door to sign.

comments.author: Ravi
comments.text: A board by the door sounds easy. Who keeps the pen?

comments.author: Ines
comments.text: Tied to the board with string, it has not gone missing yet.

comments.author: Ana
comments.text: Can we try it for a month first?
